get_colors: generate a list of random RGB color tuples for visualizing N distinct tracked points
get_points_on_a_grid: generate a uniform NxN grid of 2D point coordinates as a PyTorch tensor over a given extent
paint_point_track: overlay colored tracked point dots onto video frames using bilinear interpolation and visibility masks
preprocess_video_input: read a video file, resize it to preview and model input resolutions, and initialize tracking state
track: run CoTracker3 point tracking on a video using selected query points or an auto-generated grid
